title: Forget Dropshipping. This Side Hustle Is 10x Easier (and Smarter)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The guest says a friend owns Everbee, and the host discusses his own FourthWall merch store. No paid relationship is disclosed.

idea.name: AI-assisted Etsy print on demand
idea.one_liner: Research proven Etsy products, create original AI-assisted designs, and sell physical goods through print-on-demand fulfillment.
idea.customer: Etsy shoppers searching for relevant products.
idea.offer: Designed shirts, sweatshirts, hats, mugs, cards and other print-on-demand products.
idea.revenue_model: Margin on each sale after the marketplace listing fee and print-on-demand fulfillment costs.

acquisition_channels.details: List products on Etsy and use its existing search demand; the speaker also mentions Amazon Merch as another outlet for the same graphics.
Use Etsy's existing organic search rankings and product research to target keywords with proven demand.
Optional extension: run Google Shopping ads to a Shopify store for products already selling on Etsy.

ideas.delivery: Research Etsy products, generate original graphics with AI, prepare and publish listings, then route orders to a print-on-demand provider that prints and ships to buyers. The guest says much of the workflow can be automated, with research and final publishing still needing attention.

prices: Perplexity Pro: $20/month, as stated by the host
Etsy listing fee: 20 or 30 cents, speaker unsure

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK copyright and trade mark rights matter: the speaker describes generating versions from competitor product images and warns about trade mark takedowns. Use original or licensed designs and check protected phrases.

idea.name: Build and manage print-on-demand merch stores for creators
idea.one_liner: Find creators without merch, develop designs from their recurring phrases, build and run their stores, and take a share of sales.
idea.customer: Creators with engaged audiences who are not already selling merchandise.
idea.offer: Merch ideas and mockups, a functioning store, ongoing design additions, and store management.
idea.revenue_model: The host proposes 5% of revenue with no upfront charge; a later example discusses 5% of shirt profit, so the basis is inconsistent in the transcript.

acquisition_channels.details: The proposal includes DMing creators on Instagram with a merch offer.
Find creator email addresses through profiles or channel scraping, validate them, then send a campaign offering a prepared merch store.

ideas.delivery: Review creator transcripts for recurring phrases, create sample merch designs, pitch the creator, set up a store using Shopify or FourthWall, add designs and manage the store, and have a print-on-demand provider fulfill orders.

prices: 5% of revenue proposed; later example uses 5% of shirt profit

uk_legal_risk.reason: The suggested Instagram DMs may target creators who are individuals or sole traders, for whom unsolicited marketing by social DM is banned in the UK. Cold email is allowed only to limited companies and must include an opt-out; the suggested creator list may include individuals or sole traders.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies when collecting and using personal data such as creator email addresses. Get rights or permission for creator names, catchphrases, and artwork used on merchandise.
